# nexus piholeblocking

Verbs: get, stop, start

## Usage

```
nexus piholeblocking [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for piholeblocking
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus piholeblocking get`](nexus_piholeblocking_get.md) | Get Pi-hole blocking state |
| [`nexus piholeblocking start`](nexus_piholeblocking_start.md) | Start Pi-hole blocking |
| [`nexus piholeblocking stop`](nexus_piholeblocking_stop.md) | Stop Pi-hole blocking |
